facts: The XML bridge maps SensitivityAssignment, X, Y and Independent into sensitivityGroup.
The onboard sensitivityGroup conversion retains both x and y for DPI_Clutch.
The sensitivity conversion stores get_X at output+12, get_Y at output+16 and get_Independent at output+8.
The source conversion explicitly rejects physical wheel inputs9/10 for clutch.
The serializer writes the two separate source scalars at native record+0x30 and+0x34 as big-endian16-bit values into action offsets3..4 and5..6.
At1004C208 this serializer constructs the assignment payload;1004C240 calls CProtocol25 vtable+0x248, the exact02/0C ten-byte assignment setter1002E2D0.
Its independent clutch branch writes the same06 05 05 prefix and separate big-endian16-bit values from native record+0x30/+0x34.
CStorage.SetProfileData100524C0 calls serializer10051780, including its mouse assignment branch that dispatches through native protocol vtable+0x278.

implemented_contract.uniform_decode: Equal axis bytes continue to decode as legacy Shift(value); explicit ShiftXY equal-axis intent can remain in a saved plan because native equality is checked by bytes.
implemented_contract.input_scope: Normal and Hypershift physical inputs1/2/3/4/5/96; wheel9/10 on both layers rejects all sensitivity actions.
implemented_contract.transaction: Existing exact assignment selectors, fresh prewrite ownership and parent checks, readback, uncertain-write no-retry and conditional exact-original recovery are unchanged.
implemented_contract.frontend: DA-only independent X/Y checkbox and axis inputs; legacy uniform editor unchanged. No software DPI runtime implementation added.

validation.import_and_saved_UI_native_cross: Owned separately by the strict source-import test suite; authored source fixtures and memory transports, not a hardware export/capture.

limitations: Static source/native serializer facts and reconstructed HID reports are not physical-device validation.
No macro event/input identity gate, lighting capability or other model capability is widened.
No full-model compatibility acceptance is claimed.
